decisions.decision: Council on Aging gas generator deleted from the capital plan.
decisions.quote: council on aging- gas generator- delete from plan

decisions.decision: DPW road rehab removed from the plan, to be funded by other means; street sweeper, Townsend Harbor Road/Mulpus Road intersection and Lancaster Avenue 4-way flasher sent back for more information.
decisions.quote: road rehab- remove from plan. will be funded by other means.

decisions.decision: ADA ramp at Eagle House removed from the plan pending further resolution; pickup with plow and Holman Street/West Street building demolition remain on the plan.
decisions.quote: ada ramp between parking lots at eagle house- no schematic available. remove from plan pending further resolution.

decisions.decision: Fire Department: Rescue 2 ambulance and equipment remain on the plan; Car 2 (fire car) deleted from the plan.
decisions.quote: replace car 2 (fire car)- delete from plan.

decisions.decision: Historical Commission repaint of Town Hall and chimney rebuild remain on the plan.
decisions.quote: repaint town hall & rebuild chimney- remain on plan.

decisions.decision: Police: portable radios, ATV and speed sign with recording system removed from the plan; patrol cars and pistols & holsters remain; shotguns to be handled under the Department budget.
decisions.quote: shotguns- dollar amount not sufficient for capital plan. should be under department budget.

decisions.decision: School Department: HVAC controls, mobile media carts, and asbestos remediation remain on the plan; cafe and teachers' lunchroom floor replacement remains with a new figure.
decisions.quote: floor replacement in café & teachers' lunchroom- remain on plan. new figure of $16,000.00.

decisions.decision: Chair Benson will contact the Police Chief to reschedule the police vehicle viewing.
decisions.quote: chair benson will contact police chief marino to reschedule vehicle viewing.

decisions.decision: Committee would like to meet again with the IT Director and make a site visit to the Public Works Facility.
decisions.quote: committee would like to meet again with it director and also a site visit to the public works facility.

decisions.decision: Committee noted it is requesting mileage and hours on any Town-owned vehicle listed on a Form B; Form B to be revised for the next FY.
decisions.quote: form b will be revised for the next fy.
